contentHtml:
A Network Attached Storage device gives your home or small office one central, reliable place to store, share and back up files, instead of scattered copies across laptops, phones and USB drives. I supply, configure and set up Synology and QNAP systems from scratch around Stretton and Brisbane, or take over an existing one that is not behaving.

Scattered files are a backup waiting to fail

When photos live on one phone, documents on one laptop and old files on a USB drive in a drawer, everything is a single point of failure. A properly set up NAS fixes that, one drive array, reachable from every device on the network, with redundancy built in so a single dead drive does not lose your data.

Configured properly, not just plugged in

  • Drive and RAID setup chosen to balance capacity against protection, so a failed disk does not mean lost files.
  • Shared folders and permissions, so the right people reach the right files and nobody trips over each other.
  • Remote access, so you can get to your files securely when you are out of the house or office.
  • Backup integration, so the NAS itself is backed up too, because a NAS is not a backup on its own.

A NAS is also the ideal home for a Plex media server, and it pairs well with cloud backup for an off-site copy. For simpler needs there is data backup and transfer.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
